_comment: Found pages roll a bucket by weight, then a word within it uniformly, so `weight` is this bucket's share
of pages whatever it lists. `default`: every word no bucket lists is common, authored and derived alike,
so this list only ever needs the words moved OUT of it. The four weights are 66/20/12/2: two pages in
three are filler, one in five a staple, one in eight uncommon and one in fifty rare. A loot table may
narrow the roll with `"rarity": "rare"` or a list, on `roll_page_word` and `fill_notebook` alike.
